common.tagline: Your private companion for a healthy family
common.principle: Merros never tells anyone whom to marry or what to decide. Success means understanding, timely access to qualified counselling, and confident personal choice.

ds.title: Design system
ds.intro: Every token, typeface, component and state used in Merros. Screens may only use what is shown here.
ds.coloursNote: Burgundy is the brand colour, never a warning colour. Data cyan is for numbers and charts only. Ink variants keep gold and cyan text at WCAG AA in Pearl mode.
ds.typeNote: Sora for Latin display, Readex Pro for body and UI in both scripts, tabular figures for data.
ds.spacingNote: Spacing 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128. Radius 12 controls, 20 cards, 28 hero panels, full pills.
ds.statesNote: Hover, press, focus and disabled are shown on every interactive element. Try Tab to see the focus glow.
ds.cardBody: Frosted glass, hairline border, top edge highlight. Hover with a mouse to see the gentle tilt and moving light.
ds.goldCardBody: Gold is reserved for consent, the reveal and a shared gene.
ds.pillsNote: Every content block and AI message carries exactly one label. Clinical advice only comes from a named, accredited human.
ds.inputHint: Optional. Only your counsellor will see this.
ds.inputError: Please write at least three words so your counsellor understands.
ds.choiceLegend: How would you like to read your result?
ds.switchLabel: Share only shared carrier genes with my partner
ds.switchDesc: For 90 days. You can withdraw at any time.
ds.dataNote: Numbers count up gently and use tabular figures. Risk is never shown in red.
ds.fourSummary: When both parents are carriers, each pregnancy has a 1 in 4 chance of being affected, a 2 in 4 chance of being a carrier, and a 1 in 4 chance of being neither.
ds.hundredSummary: Out of 100 pregnancies, about 25 would be affected, about 50 would be carriers and about 25 would be neither.
ds.emptyBody: When you book a session with a genetic counsellor, it will appear here with everything you need to prepare.
ds.errorTitle: We couldn't load this right now
ds.errorBody: Your information is safe. Please try again in a moment.
ds.sheetBody: On phones, actions open in a sheet within reach of your thumb. On larger screens it floats in the centre.
ds.helixNote: Lazy loaded 3D. With reduced motion or no WebGL, the still helix is shown instead.
ds.motionNote: Easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), 300 to 700 ms, staggered 50 ms. Difficult news is never revealed abruptly.
ds.combinedNote: combined chance per pregnancy when a couple shares two carrier genes (1 − ¾ × ¾)
ds.combinedSummary: Out of 100 pregnancies, about 44 would be affected by at least one of the two conditions.
ds.perPregnancyGrid: One shared gene, out of 100 pregnancies
ds.accentsNote: Eyebrow pills, gradient display text, the glowing horizon, floating status chips with corner dots, live badges, stat rows and the dot meter. Use them for moments that matter, never as decoration alone.

landing.title: Healthy families, planned together.
landing.body: Merros helps couples understand their carrier results, plan with a qualified genetic counsellor and choose what is right for them. It explains results in Arabic and English, protects couples so nobody sees more than they agreed to, and never tells anyone what to decide.
landing.f1Body: Nothing is shared by default. Every view of your data is recorded in a tamper evident log.
landing.f2Body: Every risk figure comes from tested, deterministic code, never from an AI model.
landing.f3Body: When it matters, Merros routes you to a named, licensed genetic counsellor.
landing.heroBody: Merros explains premarital and preconception carrier results in Arabic and English, protects couples so nobody sees more than they agreed to, and connects you to a qualified genetic counsellor when it matters.
landing.status: Arabic first · Private by design · Abu Dhabi pilot ready
landing.stat1: chance per pregnancy when both partners carry the same gene
landing.stat2: personal identifiers ever sent to an AI model
landing.stat3: of risk numbers come from tested code, never AI
landing.stat4: languages, Arabic first, with right to left layout
landing.stillSealed: Every other gene stays sealed for both partners.
landing.matchNote: Only the gene you share is revealed. Everything else stays sealed.
landing.journeyBody: From a lab signed result to a confident, personal decision, every step is private, explained and linked to real people.
landing.explorerBody: Change who carries a gene and watch the chance for each pregnancy update. Every number comes from the same tested engine Merros uses for real results.
landing.sharedHint: Couples who share more than one carrier gene have a higher combined chance.
landing.perPregnancy: chance a baby is affected by at least one condition
landing.formulaOne: Both carry one changed copy: 1 in 4 each pregnancy.
landing.formulaNone: A baby can only be affected if both partners carry the same gene.
landing.explorerCta: Try it with a real story
landing.explorerDisclaimer: A learning tool. A personal result comes from your lab and a counsellor.

login.title: Choose a demo persona

onboarding.title: Welcome to Merros
onboarding.langBody: You can change this at any time.
onboarding.levelTitle: How would you like things explained?
onboarding.mediaTitle: Would you like to read, listen, or both?
onboarding.audioDesc: Spoken explanations, read aloud on your device
onboarding.aboutTitle: Are you pregnant or planning a pregnancy?
onboarding.aboutBody: This helps us make sure timing works for you. It is optional.
onboarding.consentBody: Nothing is switched on unless you choose it. You can change any of these later in Privacy.
onboarding.nothingShown: Your result stays sealed until you choose to see it.

import.title: Your screening result has arrived
import.body: Your result was sent by {lab}. It is digitally signed, so Merros checks the signature before opening it. If anything was changed on the way, Merros will refuse it.
import.verifiedBody: The result is exactly what the lab sent. It is now stored encrypted, and only you can open it.
import.rejectedBody: The signature did not match, which means the result may have been changed after the lab signed it. Nothing was stored. In real life, the lab would be asked to resend it.
import.noConsentBody: You have not asked to see your result. That is your right. You can change your mind any time.
import.noneBody: There is no result from a screening lab for you right now.

result.title: Your result
result.vusBody: In {gene}. It is not counted in any risk number.
result.counsellorFinding: A finding to discuss with a counsellor
result.noVariantsTitle: No changes found on the tested genes
result.seeCouple: What this means for us as a couple
result.askAdviceDone: A counsellor will help with your question
result.noConsentBody: You chose not to see your result yet. You can change this whenever you are ready.
result.noneTitle: You have no screening result yet
result.noneBody: If you are planning a pregnancy, carrier screening can tell you more. Here is what it involves and where to get it.
result.waitingTitle: Your result is ready to open
result.copyPairLabel: Two copies of a gene: one working copy and one changed copy. The working copy keeps you healthy.
result.statCarrier: genes where you are a carrier
result.updatedNote: This result was updated after scientists reclassified a variant. Your counsellor has discussed the change with you.
result.panelScope: The Abu Dhabi premarital genetic panel. It covers autosomal recessive genes only. It does not include X linked, Y linked or dominant genes, and it does not cover every recessive condition.
result.panelOutside: If a genetic condition is known in your family and its gene is not on this panel, a clinical geneticist is the right person to talk to.
result.panelSearch: Search a gene, for example GBA
result.panelNoMatch: That gene is not on this panel.
result.panelSource: Source: Department of Health Abu Dhabi, Premarital Screening Standard DoH/STD/PSS/V3 (September 2024), Appendix 12. Names updated to current HGNC symbols; older names in brackets.

couple.title: Your result as a couple
couple.sharedTitle: You both carry a change in {gene}
couple.perPregnancy: chance in each pregnancy that a baby is affected by {condition}
couple.carrierChance: {pct}% chance a baby is a carrier like you
couple.combinedBody: chance in each pregnancy that a baby is affected by at least one of these conditions
couple.combinedHow: Calculated as 1 − (1 − ¼) × (1 − ¼). Each pregnancy is independent.
couple.hundredSummary: Out of 100 pregnancies, about {n} would be affected by at least one of the conditions.
couple.noneSharedTitle: You do not share a carrier gene on the tested panel
couple.noneSharedBody: This lowers the chance of the conditions tested, but it does not make it zero. No test can find everything.
couple.privacyNote: You only see genes you both carry. Neither of you can see the rest of the other's result.
couple.phaseNote: The match ran on your two phones.
couple.awaitingSelfBody: Turn your key to agree. Your phones then compare your results without showing them to each other, or to Merros. Either of you can say no without the other being told why.
couple.awaitingPartnerBody: Your side is sealed and ready. The match completes when your partner turns their key on their own phone. We tell them nothing about your result.
couple.noPartnerBody: Couple comparison is available when both partners use Merros.
couple.heroAccentShared: {count, plural, one {You share one carrier gene.} other {You share # carrier genes.}}
couple.dualKeyLabel: Dual key: each partner agrees independently before anything is compared.
couple.statSeen: other genes either of you can see
couple.workingBody: Checking the lab signature and blinding your genes on this device.
couple.readyBody: Take a breath. Open it when you are ready, alone or together.
couple.needResultBody: The private match uses your lab signed result, so you need to have opened it before comparing.
couple.deviceNote: The match ran on your two phones. The Merros server only passed sealed points between you and cannot tell which genes you share.
couple.serverSees: What the server relayed: {n} sealed points from each phone, twice. No gene names.
couple.talkShareNote: This shares which genes you both carry with your genetic counsellor. Until you press it, Merros does not know your match.
couple.errorBody: The private match could not run. Your result is safe and nothing was shared.
couple.sharedResultBody: You both carry a change in the same gene. This is common, and it is something to plan for together, not a judgement about you or your relationship.

learn.title: Learn
learn.body: Plain language guides to conditions common in the region. Written for Merros and pending accredited clinical review.

teachback.title: Check your understanding
teachback.body: A few gentle questions. There are no wrong people, only explanations that can be better.
teachback.notQuite: Not quite. Here is another way to think about it.
teachback.doneBody: You answered {before} of {total} on the first try and {after} of {total} in the end.
teachback.doneEscalated: Some parts may be easier with a person. We have offered you a counsellor.
teachback.question: Question {n} of {total}

options.title: Your options
options.body: Every option is shown with equal weight. Merros never ranks them or tells you what to choose.
options.values: Not sure which fits you? The Values Compass relates each option to what matters to you.
options.talk: Talk these through with a counsellor
options.toValues: See how options fit my values

support.title: Care and counselling
support.noneTitle: You can talk to a counsellor any time
support.noneBody: Nothing in your journey needs a counsellor right now, but you are always welcome to book.
support.mode: How would you like to meet?
support.simulated: Booking is simulated in this demo.
support.prepare: Before your session, write down any questions, and decide whether you would like your partner or a family member with you.
support.heroAccentReasons: A counsellor can help, at your pace.
support.heroAccentAlways: Someone to talk to, whenever you need.
support.questionsPlaceholder: For example: what does this mean for our children?
support.questionsHint: Stored encrypted. Only the clinician you book sees them, and only if you allowed counsellor access.

pathway.title: Your journey
pathway.body: Every step, at your pace. The steps follow the Abu Dhabi premarital screening process.
pathway.specialist_service: Referral: clinical geneticist, haemoglobinopathy service or reproductive medicine
pathway.screening_visit: Screening visit: consent given, samples taken
pathway.report_issued: Premarital Screening and Counselling Report issued

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: You own your data. Nothing is shared unless you choose it, and every access is recorded.
privacy.historyEmpty: No one has accessed your data yet.
privacy.integrity: Check the record has not been altered
privacy.integrityBody: Every entry is chained to the one before it with a cryptographic hash. Any edit, deletion or insertion breaks the chain.
privacy.broken: The record was altered at entry {seq}.
privacy.exportBody: A file with everything Merros holds about you, readable by you.
privacy.deleteBody: Permanently removes your account, result, consents and journey. The access record keeps only anonymous entries so it can still be verified.
privacy.deleteConfirmLabel: Type DELETE or حذف to confirm
privacy.relatives: Relatives are stored only by relationship label, never by name.

actions.psi_round_relayed: Sealed points relayed for the private match
actions.couple_outcome_shared: Shared carrier result told to counsellor
actions.reclassification_detected: A variant in your result was reclassified

screening.title: Carrier screening before pregnancy
screening.body: For couples outside the premarital programme, including married couples and residents planning a pregnancy.
screening.who1: Couples planning a pregnancy who have not had carrier screening
screening.who2: Couples who are related, such as cousins
screening.who3: Anyone with a relative who has, or carries, an inherited condition
screening.whatBody: A blood or saliva test that looks for changes in genes linked to conditions such as thalassaemia, sickle cell disease and SMA. It shows chance, not a diagnosis.
screening.whereBody: Ask your family doctor or a genetic counsellor, or use Find Care to see services near you.

home.allDoneBody: Your counsellor will be in touch. You can revisit anything below.

counsellor.title: Case queue
counsellor.body: Sorted by urgency. Details are visible only when the person has consented to counsellor access.
counsellor.emptyBody: When someone needs a genetic counsellor, their case will appear here with the reason.
counsellor.noAccess: This person has not shared their result with a counsellor. You can see only that support was offered.
counsellor.tasksBadge: {count, plural, =0 {No variant updates} one {# variant update} other {# variant updates}}
counsellor.livingEmpty: No variant has been reclassified. Merros checks ClinVar and the national feed, and tells you first, never the patient directly.
counsellor.releaseHint: The person has not been told. Speak to them first, then release the updated result to their app.
counsellor.release: I have told the patient: release the update

admin.title: Population Signals
admin.body: What the programme can learn from thousands of journeys, without learning anything about any one person.
admin.statement: Merros does not track marriage outcomes or any single personal decision as a success measure.
admin.affected: {count, plural, one {# person affected} other {# people affected}}
admin.watchBody: VariantWatch checks every watched variant against ClinVar each night. You can also run it now.
admin.watchFailed: ClinVar could not be reached. Nothing was changed.

tour.passcodeTooMany: Too many attempts. Please try again in an hour.
tour.nightly: The demo data resets itself every night.

welcome.title: Welcome to Merros
welcome.body: This short tour walks you through Merros in about 4 minutes, following one couple, Mariam and Khalid, from result day to a year later. Buttons marked Presenter control simulate things that normally take months or two phones. You can leave the tour at any time.

result.title: Mariam's result day
result.body: Mariam chooses what to share, step by step. Her result arrives signed by the lab and Merros checks the signature before opening it (the presenter control shows a tampered delivery being refused). She reads it in plain language, then Teach Back checks her understanding and explains again in a new way when needed.

match.title: Blind Couple Match and Your plan
match.body: Mariam turns her key; use the presenter control to switch to Khalid's phone and turn his. Only the genes they both carry are revealed, as a shared carrier result, never a verdict. It ends with Your plan: counselling, every option, one next step.

brief.title: Dr. Layla prepares
brief.body: Dr. Layla's pre session brief shows the couple's result, questions and understanding before they meet. She writes her notes, the Counsellor Copilot drafts a summary in plain language, and nothing reaches the patient until she reviews and signs it.

living.title: One year later: Living Results
living.body: Science changes. Use the presenter control Simulate ClinVar update: Dr. Layla is told first, speaks to the patient, then releases the updated, lab signed result. People who did not ask to be told are never contacted.

signals.title: The health system
signals.body: Population Signals help plan counselling from privacy protected statistics. Each release spends part of a visible privacy budget, small groups are hidden, and no one is tracked.

copilot.title: Genetic Copilot in Arabic
copilot.body: Ask in Gulf Arabic; every number comes from the tested risk engine.

family.title: Family Risk Engine
family.body: Each relative's chance of being a carrier, stored by relationship, never by name.

beyond.title: Risk Beyond the Panel
beyond.body: For related couples, an estimate the panel cannot see, seen by the counsellor first.

findCare.title: Find Care
findCare.body: Kinds of genetic services near you, with filters and a map.

values.title: Values Compass
values.body: How each option relates to what matters to you, never ranked.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Every consent, who saw what, and a tamper evident audit log.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: Your information is safe. Please try again.
errors.notFoundTitle: We could not find that page
errors.notFoundBody: It may have moved. Let's take you somewhere useful.

copilot.title: Ask anything about your result
copilot.body: The Copilot explains results, conditions, chances and options from approved Merros content. Every number comes from the tested risk engine. It never tells you what to decide, and it offers a genetic counsellor when a person is the right answer.
copilot.placeholder: Ask about your result, a condition or your options
copilot.thinking: The Copilot is preparing an answer
copilot.q1: What does being a carrier mean?
copilot.q2: We are both carriers. What is the chance for each pregnancy?
copilot.counsellor: A genetic counsellor can help with this.
copilot.offlineNote: Answered by the offline demo model, which composes approved content without a language model. Connect Claude for natural conversation.
copilot.disclaimer: The Copilot gives education and decision support, not clinical advice. Your conversation is not stored. Content is pending accredited clinical review.
copilot.errMic: Microphone access was not allowed. You can still type your question.
copilot.errNotUnderstood: Nothing was heard clearly. Please try again, or type your question.
copilot.errTooLong: That was too long. Please ask in under 20 seconds.
copilot.errFailed: Voice is not available right now. You can still type your question.

family.title: Who in your family may want to know
family.body: When someone is a carrier, relatives have a higher chance of being carriers too. Add relatives by relationship and Merros estimates each one's chance, so you can decide whom to tell. Sharing is always your choice.
family.parentsRelated: My parents are related to each other
family.statYield: carriers expected if all were tested
family.emptyBody: Add a relative below, for example a sibling or a cousin, to see their estimated chance of being a carrier.
family.rankNote: Ordered by chance of being a carrier. Adults planning marriage or pregnancy come first among equals.
family.constellationSummary: {count, plural, one {A map of # relative} other {A map of # relatives}} around you, brighter where the chance of being a carrier is higher.
family.addBody: Choose the relationship only. Merros never asks for a name, phone number or date of birth.
family.planning: An adult planning marriage or a pregnancy
family.inviteBody: Create a link you can send yourself, by any app you like. The page it opens explains carrier screening. It does not say who sent it, which gene is involved, or how you are related.
family.inviteHint: Merros never contacts your relatives. Only you decide who receives a link.
family.method: How this is worked out: each relative's chance of carrying the family change in {gene} follows Mendelian inheritance (for example 1 in 2 for a sibling, 1 in 8 for a first cousin), then a population carrier frequency of {f} ({population}) is added for the chance of a different change in the same gene. Testing a parent tells us which side of the family it comes from.
family.relatedNote: Because your parents are related, the change could come from either side, so both sides keep the same estimate. This is an approximation; a genetic counsellor can work it out exactly.
family.noCarrierTitle: The family map opens once you are a known carrier
family.noCarrierBody: Family estimates start from a confirmed carrier result. Open your result first, or talk to a counsellor.

invite.eyebrow: A private note from your family
invite.title: Someone in your family thought this might help you
invite.accent: It is your choice what to do next.
invite.body: A relative has had genetic carrier screening and wanted you to know that screening is available to you too. They chose to share this page. Nothing about them or their result is shown here.
invite.private: This page does not know who you are, and it does not show who sent it. Merros has not been given your name or contact details.
invite.whyBody: Carrier changes are passed down in families, so relatives of a carrier are more likely to be carriers themselves. Carriers are healthy. It matters mainly when planning a family, because a child can be affected only if both parents carry a change in the same gene.
invite.where: You can ask your family doctor or a genetic counsellor about carrier screening.
invite.choice: You do not have to do anything. Some people want to know before marriage or pregnancy, and some prefer not to. Both are valid choices.
invite.invalidTitle: This invitation link is not valid
invite.invalidBody: It may have been mistyped. You can still learn about carrier screening from your family doctor.

findCare.title: Find the right person to talk to
findCare.body: Genetic counsellors, family doctors, fertility and PGT-M clinics, maternal fetal medicine, haematology and psychology in Abu Dhabi, Al Ain and Al Dhafra. Filter by what matters to you, then book.
findCare.doctorSheetBody: {name} will be saved as your family doctor. Nothing about your result is shared unless you switch on the option below.
findCare.doctorShare: Share a carrier summary with my family doctor
findCare.doctorShareDesc: Which genes you carry, for 90 days. Never your partner's result. You can withdraw in Privacy.
findCare.emptyBody: Try a wider distance, another language, or clear the filters to see everyone.
findCare.synthetic: All providers and locations are fictional.

brief.noFindings: No changes found on the tested genes.
brief.noResult: They have not opened a result.
brief.coupleShared: Shared carrier result, told by the patient: {genes}.
brief.coupleUnknown: Shared carrier result: not told to you. The match runs on the couple's phones, and Merros does not know the outcome unless they choose to tell you.
brief.pedigreeNote: Relationships only. Estimates from the Family Risk Engine; your own pedigree analysis takes precedence.
brief.summaryIntro: Write your notes, let the Copilot draft a patient friendly summary, then edit and sign it. The patient sees only what you sign.
brief.notesPlaceholder: Key points discussed, next steps agreed, anything to follow up.
brief.draftLabel: Summary for the patient ({language}): review and edit
brief.draftHint: A draft only. You are responsible for every statement once you sign.
brief.signed: Signed and released. The session is marked completed.
brief.offline: Drafted by the offline demo model, which only adds an opening and closing to your notes.
brief.noSessionWithYou: This person has no session booked with you.
brief.reportBody: The screening facility issues the report after results counselling, and the signing physician controls its release. Merros records only that it was issued.
brief.reportMark: Record that the report was issued
brief.reportAfterCounselling: Can be recorded once results counselling is done.

session.title: Video session
session.note: This room is a simulation for the demo. No camera or microphone is used.
session.adviceNote: Clinical advice comes only from your named counsellor

signals.accent: Private by mathematics, not by promise.
signals.noRelease: No release has been published yet.
signals.noiseNote: Each number carries random noise of about ±{n}.
signals.mapBody: Results received in each region over 26 weeks.
signals.mapLabel: Schematic map of Al Dhafra, Abu Dhabi and Al Ain with the number of results received in each
signals.funnelBody: How many people reach each step, by region.
signals.waitBody: Days from the offer to the booked session.
signals.typicalUnknown: Typical wait hidden: a group is under 10
signals.forecastBody: Booked sessions per week across the programme, and where demand is heading, so counsellors can be scheduled in advance.
signals.forecastAria: Line chart of booked counselling sessions per week for 26 weeks, followed by an 8 week forecast
signals.forecastNone: Too many weeks are hidden to forecast safely.
signals.forecastMethod: Method: damped trend exponential smoothing on published numbers only. It is a planning aid, not a prediction about any person.
signals.regionNoForecast: Not enough data to plan safely
signals.capacityNote: Staffing uses a planning assumption of {n} sessions per counsellor per week.
signals.compBody: Share who understood on the first try, by language and reading level. A lower bar shows where the explanations need work, not who struggled.
signals.wellBody: For people who completed a session and answered both times.
signals.sure: Felt sure about their decision (SURE test)
signals.distress: Reported high distress (4 or more out of 10)
signals.wellSynthetic: Almost all of these numbers come from the synthetic journeys. Live answers from the Distress Check and the Values Compass are added as people complete them.
signals.safetyQuestions: Copilot questions (at most 3 counted per person)
signals.relativesTested: relatives who went on to test
signals.budgetBody: Every release spends part of a fixed budget. When it is used up, nothing more can be published until the next quarter, however useful it would be.
signals.budgetReleases: {n, plural, one {# release} other {# releases}} this quarter
signals.published: A new release was published with fresh noise.
signals.exhausted: Refused: the budget for this quarter cannot pay for another release.
signals.ledgerTitle: How this release spent its budget
signals.ledgerSensitivity: One person can change it by
signals.how1: Each person is counted at most once in each number, so one person can only change a number by a known, small amount.
signals.how2: Random noise sized to that amount is added to every number before it is stored. The true numbers are never saved or shown.
signals.how3: Any number under 10 after noise is hidden.
signals.how4: Nothing is broken down by tribe, family name or any identity group.

wellbeing.title: How are you feeling?
wellbeing.body: A result can stir up a lot. This one question helps Merros offer the right support. There is no right or wrong answer.
wellbeing.question: How much distress have you felt in the past week, including today?
wellbeing.hint: Slide to choose a number from 0 to 10.
wellbeing.callbackTitle: Would you like someone to call you this week?
wellbeing.callbackBody: A genetic counsellor can talk through what the result means. A psychologist can help with how it feels. You choose, and you can choose neither.
wellbeing.doneCounsellor: Requested. A genetic counsellor will call you this week (simulated in this demonstration).
wellbeing.donePsychologist: Requested. A psychologist will call you this week (simulated in this demonstration).
wellbeing.crisisTitle: If you feel unsafe right now
wellbeing.privacy: Your answer is private. Your counsellor sees it only if you gave them access. Anonymous statistics count it only if you agreed to that.

values.title: Values Compass
values.body: Say what matters to you, and see how each option relates to it. Merros does not choose for you, and no option is ranked above another.
values.rateBody: Rate each one. There are no right answers, and you can change them any time.
values.relateTitle: How the options relate to what you said
values.relateBody: For the things you rated very important or essential. The options are in the same order as in Options, which is different for every person. This is a starting point for your own thinking and for a conversation, not advice.
values.relateEmpty: Rate all seven above to see this.
values.noneImportant: You did not rate anything as very important or essential, so there is nothing to compare. That is a valid answer.
values.sureBody: The SURE test. It shows whether more information or support would help before you decide.
values.shareLabel: Share my Values Summary with my genetic counsellor
values.shareDesc: Off unless you turn it on. Lasts 90 days and can be withdrawn in Privacy.
values.saved: Saved, encrypted with your own key.
values.sureAll: You answered yes to all four. You seem comfortable with where you are. You can still talk to a counsellor at any time.
values.sureSome: You answered no to at least one. That is common, and it usually means more information or support would help. A genetic counsellor can go through it with you.
values.incomplete: Rate all seven and answer the four questions to save.
values.source: Based on the Ottawa Decision Support Framework and the SURE test (Légaré and others, 2010). The Arabic wording of the SURE test is a working translation.

beyond.title: What the gene panel cannot see
beyond.body: A panel checks a list of known gene changes. Couples who are related share longer stretches of identical DNA, which adds a small chance of rarer conditions that are not on any panel. This analysis estimates that chance from how much DNA you share.
beyond.point1: It runs only if you both agree. Either of you can withdraw at any time, and the analysis is then deleted.
beyond.point2: The result goes to a genetic counsellor first, who talks it through with you before you see it here.
beyond.point3: It measures how related two people are. Sometimes that shows more, or less, relatedness than a family expected.
beyond.consentLabel: I agree to the Risk Beyond the Panel analysis
beyond.consentDesc: Off unless you turn it on. Lasts 90 days.
beyond.withdrawDesc: Turn off to withdraw. The analysis is then deleted for both of you.
beyond.neitherAgreed: Neither of you has agreed yet.
beyond.waitingPartner: You have agreed. Waiting for {name} to decide. Nothing has been analysed.
beyond.partnerAgreed: {name} has agreed. Nothing is analysed unless you agree too.
beyond.withCounsellor: The analysis is ready and is with your genetic counsellor. They will go through it with you both before it appears here.
beyond.unavailable: This analysis needs whole genome data from both partners, which this demonstration does not have for your couple.

band.background: Your chance is about the same as for any couple.
band.slightly_above: Your chance is slightly above that of unrelated couples.
band.moderately_above: Your chance is moderately above that of unrelated couples. Most children of couples related like this are healthy.
band.individual_assessment: You share more DNA than the published figures cover, so a genetic counsellor needs to assess this with you individually.

beyond.statShared: of your DNA is shared on one copy
beyond.statChild: of a child's DNA expected to match on both copies
beyond.statExtra: added chance of a significant childhood condition, above any couple's
beyond.nadTitle: This is an estimate, not a diagnosis
beyond.nadBody: It describes a chance across many couples related the way you are. It cannot say what will happen in your family, it does not name a condition, and it does not replace the gene panel or a counsellor's advice.
beyond.method: Worked out by tested code from the measured shared DNA, scaled from the published figures for first cousins (Bennett and others, 2002).
beyond.synthetic: Demonstration: the DNA data is synthetic and was not produced by a genomics pipeline.
beyond.cExtra: added risk above the population baseline

consistency.consistent: The measured sharing is consistent with the relationship the couple declared ({relationship}).
consistency.more_than_declared: The couple shares clearly more DNA than their declared relationship ({relationship}) predicts. This may be relatedness they do not know about. Consider how, and whether, to raise it.
consistency.less_than_declared: The couple shares clearly less DNA than their declared relationship ({relationship}) predicts. This may mean the family tree is not as they believe. Consider how, and whether, to raise it.

beyond.mapTitle: {n} shared segments, {mb} Mb, {pct}% of the autosomes
beyond.mapLabel: The 22 autosomes as bars, with the segments the partners share marked
beyond.limit1: A population level estimate. It cannot predict the outcome for this couple or name a condition.
beyond.limit2: The added risk is scaled in proportion to F from one published range for first cousins. Risk also depends on family history and on variants that this cannot see.
beyond.limit3: Real sharing varies around the family tree value, so a first cousin couple can measure somewhat above or below 0.0625.
beyond.limit4: Not a substitute for the carrier panel, and not a reason on its own to advise for or against any option.
beyond.references: References: Bennett RL and others. Genetic counseling and screening of consanguineous couples and their offspring. Journal of Genetic Counseling 2002;11:97. A child's inbreeding coefficient equals the parents' kinship coefficient.
beyond.sourcePrecomputed: Demonstration data: synthetic shared segments, not produced by a genomics pipeline. The figures are computed from them by the tested engine.
beyond.releaseBody: Release only after you have talked this through with both partners. They will then see a plain language summary: the band, the three headline figures and that it is not a diagnosis. They do not see the consistency note or the segment map.
beyond.release: I have discussed this with the couple: release the summary

video.title: My Result Video
video.body: A short animated explanation of your own result, in your language. Watch it again whenever you like.
video.needResultBody: Open your result first. The video is made from it.
video.narrateDesc: Uses this device's own voice. Quality varies by device.
video.private: The video is made on this device from your result. It is not uploaded, stored or sent anywhere.
video.noNames: It contains no name or identifier, only gene names and numbers.
video.show: To show it to family, play it for them on your device. Sending it as a link is not available in this demonstration.
video.modePlayer: Played in your browser, made on your device.

plan.title: Your plan

intro.carrier: Being a carrier is common, and you are healthy. Many people with a result like yours go on to build healthy families. These three steps help you plan, at your own pace.
intro.uncertain: Part of your result is best explained by a specialist. These three steps make sure you are not left with open questions.
intro.shared: A shared carrier result is common, and many couples with one go on to build healthy families. Planning starts with three steps, and every choice along the way is yours.
intro.beyond: This estimate adds to the plan you have with your counsellor. The same three steps apply.

counsellingBody.carrier: A genetic counsellor can explain what your result means for you, and for a future partner.
counsellingBody.uncertain: A genetic counsellor will explain this part of your result and answer your questions.
counsellingBody.shared: A genetic counsellor meets you both, explains your shared carrier result and answers your questions. Telling them your match is your choice.
counsellingBody.beyond: Your counsellor has already been through this estimate and can talk about it with you both.

plan.optionsBody: There are several paths to a healthy family, and none is ranked above another. See what each involves, and how each relates to what matters to you.

teachback.body: Check that the key ideas feel clear. It takes about two minutes.

family.body: Relatives may want to know their own chance of being a carrier. You decide whom to tell, privately.

wellbeing.body: Results can bring up a lot. A one question check in makes sure you get the support you want.

plan.note: Merros never tells you whom to marry or what to decide. Your plan is yours.

sources.title: About and sources
sources.body: Where the facts, numbers and processes in Merros come from.
sources.independent: Merros is an independent prototype built for the Future Health Digital Innovation Challenge 2026. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Department of Health Abu Dhabi. It follows the Department's published Premarital Screening Standard as a public reference only.
sources.panelCounts: Panel used in Merros: {unique} genes ({printed} entries as printed, duplicates merged, {renamed} renamed to their current names).
sources.synthetic: All people, clinicians, clinics and results in Merros are synthetic. Clinical content is pending accredited review.
sources.footer: Merros is an independent prototype, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Department of Health Abu Dhabi. All data is synthetic.

doh.title: Premarital Screening Standard, Department of Health Abu Dhabi
doh.use: The gene panel (Appendix 12), the care pathway and counselling steps (section 3.3, Appendices 14 and 15), and the kinds of counselling services in Find Care (Appendix 13).

hgnc.title: HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee (HGNC)
hgnc.use: Current approved gene names, used to update the panel's gene names (complete set downloaded 16 November 2026).

clinvar.title: ClinVar, National Center for Biotechnology Information
clinvar.use: Classifications of the real variants given to the fictional personas, and the Living Results check.

medlineplus.title: MedlinePlus Genetics and GeneReviews
medlineplus.use: The basis for the plain language condition explanations, written in Merros's own words.

acmg.title: ACMG and AMP variant interpretation guidelines (2015)
acmg.use: The five classification categories used in results and by the Copilot.

bennett.title: Bennett and others, Journal of Genetic Counseling, 2002
bennett.use: The added risk range for related couples used in Risk Beyond the Panel.

sure.title: Ottawa Decision Support Framework and the SURE test (Légaré and others, 2010)
sure.use: The Values Compass and its four decision questions.

nccn.title: NCCN Distress Thermometer
nccn.use: The single question in the Distress Check.
